body:
Bisected to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113600

The PR moved the responsibility of registering loaded `GDScripts` with the `ResourceCache`. Now the `ResourceFormatLoader` for GDScript is reponsible for this, but I missed some early returns for scripts with errors. For those early returns the script is currently not added to the resource cache.

Restoring this to a pre https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113600 status is easy: just also add to the `ResourceCache` for the early returns.

However I kinda noticed that the registration to the `GDScriptCache` also only happens for scripts without errors, which is yet another way for the `GDScriptCache` and `ResourceCache` getting desynced. I might need to look into the implications of that at some point.
